::: {#hero-heading}
I'm a **Principal ML Engineer** at [Analog Devices](https://www.analog.com) in Ireland. I design and ship machine learning systems that support supply chain decisions and intelligent edge products. Over the past decade, I have worked across manufacturing, industrial, energy and semiconductor domains, taking ideas from early prototypes to reliable production systems.

My technical work centres on probabilistic time series forecasting, Bayesian modelling and production MLOps, shared as open-source tools such as [Twiga](https://sambaiga.github.io/twiga-docs/). I care about clean architecture, robust deployment, and monitoring and governance once systems are live. I work with business and product leaders to align technology roadmaps and AI investments with the value they are meant to create.

Alongside my industry role, I am active in research. My research develops methods and approaches for time series analysis and forecasting, mostly for power systems, from non-intrusive load monitoring to probabilistic net-load forecasting for low-voltage networks. In my current work at Analog Devices I develop demand forecasting methods for the semiconductor supply chain, and I am interested in innovation and technology management. I collaborate with [Lucas Pereira](https://www.alspereira.info/) at ITI, LARSyS, Técnico Lisboa on machine learning and data analytics solutions for clean energy systems and the broader energy transition. I also mentor engineers and work with product and operations teams so that the work stays close to the needs of its users.

> My mission: architect and deliver ML systems that solve real business problems with measurable impact.

### Education

::: {.about-education}
- **PhD in Computer Science and Engineering**<br>Instituto Superior Técnico (Técnico Lisboa), Portugal
- **MSc in Leadership, Innovation and Technology**<br>Technological University Dublin (TU Dublin), Ireland
- **MSc in Telecommunications Engineering**<br>University of Dodoma, Tanzania
:::

### Open to

I am open to research collaborations, technical speaking, and mentoring emerging AI engineers.
